title: Hims & Hers (HIMS): Revenue Up 49%, Gross Profit Per Member Stuck Near $60
description: Hims & Hers fell 24% this week and crossed below its 200-week line. Revenue grew 49%, but gross profit per member is about $60 a month, no higher than a year ago, stock comp eats most of adjusted EBITDA, and a $563M acquisition bill can be paid in shares. I call it a value trap at $19.73.
verdict_label: Avoid — cheap on revenue, fully priced on what each member earns
selection_rationale: HIMS topped the shortlist (score 74.6): down 24.1% on the week on 3x volume after a Q3 report with the first subscriber decline, a third EBITDA guidance cut and a Q4 revenue guide flat with Q3, plus five states joining the FTC suit, and it crossed below its 200-week line. It is the most recognisable name on the list with a live opportunity-or-trap debate and deep disclosure. The piece answers what the 49% revenue growth is made of and what the Eucalyptus deferred payments do to the share count. AAON and MOD rose on earnings and a takeover report; IONS fell on trial setbacks.
